reply:
Private reasoning: All-X war just bleeds everyone −1 a round while R1/R3's lead stays intact — attrition can't catch them. A truce converts rounds 4–7 from −1s to +1s (big expected and group gain), and posting this round costs me ~nothing if the war continues (0 vs −1). I'll set the boundary honestly at round 8 so the truce is credible, keep my grim-trigger threat to enforce it, and hold my late-defection edge in reserve.
